'''Mokkotown'''<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/retrieval-episode-guide|text="Retrieval" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> was a decrepit [[ipsium]] mining facility owned by the gang boss [[Mokko]]<ref name="Retrieval" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|210}}</ref>

==History==
Mokkotown was a mining facility located on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Ipsidon]]. It was ran by the [[Techno Union]] during the [[Clone Wars]] to mine ipsium. Following the end of the war, Techno Union was forced out and Mokko soon took over the facility and its operation.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|mokkotown|Mokkotown}}</ref>

Mokko claimed that the facility had struggled with the quantity of ipsium, lying to his [[Mokko's crew|workers]] as a means to secretly hoard the wealth and riches of the mine while his workers struggled for [[Foodstuff|food]].<ref name="Retrieval" />
